title: Make a Digital Presentation with InDesign
scope: Screen-oriented layout, guides, reusable type hierarchy, previewing, and interactive PDF delivery from the supplied presentation lesson.

questions.prompt: Your portrait branding board needs to become a landscape presentation. How would you adapt its content for readable slides?
How would you keep headline and subheading formatting consistent across eight pages?
How can you preview the presentation full-screen and return to editing?
What PDF export type does this screen-presentation lesson use, and what should you review before sharing it?

title: Fill out TAD Costing Estimator
scope: Estimate versus job request, material measurements, project milestones, and reviewing the emailed estimate. No personal or payment details are requested in this check.

questions.prompt: You submitted the costing form and need DC to design or print the project. Has a job been requested? Explain the next step.
What material information must you check so the estimate is based on the correct quantity?
What is the difference between the review-by date and the final-delivery date?
Where does the calculated estimate arrive, and what would you review before including it in a job request?

title: Spellcheck: InDesign
scope: The publisher's written lesson: spellcheck scope, correction choices, dictionary handling, and Dynamic Spelling. This is not an accessed video transcript.

questions.prompt: How would you start a spelling check for one selected text frame rather than the whole document?
A suggested spelling correction changes the intended word. What should you do instead of accepting it automatically?
InDesign flags a correctly spelled client acronym. What option can prevent repeated flags after you verify it?
What does Dynamic Spelling display, and does a marking necessarily mean a word is wrong?

title: Headline Capitalization Check
scope: Choosing the requested style and case, converting a headline, and checking the output. No single DC house style is assumed.

questions.prompt: Before converting a client's headline, how would you decide which capitalization style to select?
How does title case differ from sentence case?
Describe the basic workflow for converting a headline and bringing it back into your design.
Two style tabs produce different capitalization. How would you decide which result to use?

title: Export InDesign to PDF
scope: The supplied TAD zine/spreads export workflow, including checking the layout, naming, requested marks and bleed, and verifying exported files. Settings are not universal print requirements.

questions.prompt: What should you inspect and fix in the InDesign layout before exporting?
Which export command and PDF type are used in this print/zine lesson?
The client asks for both a clean review PDF and a version with crop marks and bleed. How would you handle the exports?
After export completes, what would you do before telling the client the PDFs are ready?

title: Package InDesign Files
scope: Linked assets, preflight, permitted font collection, packaging, and checking a complete editable handoff. Font licensing and project-specific output requirements still apply.

questions.prompt: A teammate receives only your INDD file and sees missing images. Why can that happen?
What is preflight, and name two problems you should resolve before handing off the document?
How do you start packaging, and what supporting assets should you collect when permitted?
What would you inspect in the resulting package before sending it to another designer?

title: Poster Design
scope: The Anatomy-of-Type Illustrator exercise: organized layers, meaningful type-anatomy guides, highlights and labels, and editable plus review-file delivery.

questions.prompt: Why lock the background layer before selecting and editing the poster's lines and letterforms?
Where should the x-height guide align, rather than simply placing it halfway between the other guides?
What should you check so a highlighted letterform feature and its arrow or label are understandable?
Which two file formats does this exercise request, and what purpose does each serve?

title: Mockup Templates
scope: Replacing artwork through a Photoshop template's editable design layer, updating the mockup, evaluating shading, and preparing a client PDF.

questions.prompt: How do you identify and open the mockup layer intended for your artwork?
Your pasted design appears in the editing tab but not the original mockup. What step is needed?
The template's shading texture changes your artwork too strongly. What adjustments would you evaluate?
What is the trade-off when turning off Preserve Photoshop Editing Capabilities in the PDF export?

title: Stickers / HP 330-335 Print and Cut
scope: The linked TAD HP/Graphtec lessons: vector cut paths, registration, print-file preparation, and cutter setup concepts. Passing is not authorization for unsupervised machine operation.

questions.prompt: How is the vector cut path different from the sticker artwork, and why must they align?
What is the purpose of registration marks in this print-and-cut workflow?
What happens to the grouped cut-path outlines when making the print PDF, and when cutting?
Before sending the cutter job, what alignment and registration setup should you verify with a trained supervisor?

title: Scan Artwork
scope: TAD scanning workflow: color, resolution, artwork placement, destination, finishing a job, and handling oversized artwork.

questions.prompt: Which color mode and minimum resolution does this lesson recommend for color artwork?
If you plan to enlarge a scan, how should that affect your resolution choice?
How do you place the artwork, choose the destination, and finish the job so the scans are sent?
What workflow does the lesson suggest when the artwork is too large for one scan?
